//: Cases that fail on origin/main 05673660a, with the reason. The runners report them but do not fail CI for them. `#steps` marks the steps.json part run by react-lang. Remove an id once it passes.
grammar/001-fence-line-start: A fence opens at any triple backtick, not only at the start of a line (1.2).
grammar/002-fence-prose-quote: A double quote in prose hides the fence opener (1.2).
grammar/007-statement-multiline-ternary: `a ? b :` followed by a newline ends the statement and loses the else branch (1.4 rule 3).
grammar/009-member-digits-index: `m.0.1` lexes as a decimal and plucks, instead of m[0][1] (1.5).
entry/002-first-calls-root-component: No non-fatal no-root when the first statement is the entry (2.2).
entry/003-first-not-root-component: The old fallback picks any component statement as the entry; no fatal no-root (2.2).
entry/004-root-not-a-component: No fatal no-root when root is not a component (2.2).
entry/005-first-is-state-declaration: The old fallback picks a later component statement as the entry; no fatal no-root (2.2).
entry/006-ternary-root-multiline: A root that is a ternary of component statements does not render (2.2).
streaming/002-final-redefinition-needs-c: No end of stream: a final redefinition that needs implicit closing is discarded (4 rule 7).
streaming/004-ternary-else-across-chunks: `a ? b :` followed by a newline ends the statement, in both parsers (1.4 rule 3).
evaluation/002-ref-array-unresolved: An unresolved reference is kept in an array inside a computed expression, so @Count gives 2 (2.3).
evaluation/005-op-coerce-values: `===` and `!==` are not lexed as `==` and `!=` (1.3).
evaluation/008-builtin-sort-code-point: @Sort compares strings with localeCompare, not by code point (3.4).
evaluation/009-each-nested-shadowing: A nested @Each with the same variable does not shadow the outer one (3.5).
actions/002-single-step: A lone step in an action prop is not a plan of one step (6.3).
actions/003-event-context-any-value: The @ToAssistant context is turned into a string (6.3).
editing/003-state-set-null: A `$x = null` patch deletes the state declaration instead of keeping it with default null (7).
editing/004-multiline-ternary-patch: The merge splits a multi-line ternary at its newlines (7).
editing/006-no-root-statement-no-gc: No non-fatal no-root for the merged program (2.2).
editing/007-redefinition-in-existing: A name defined twice in the existing program stays duplicated after the merge (2.4, 7).
errors/002-unknown-function-null: An unknown @Name is reported as unknown-component, not unknown-function evaluating to null (3.6).
errors/005-shape-missing-required-metric: The hint joins signature and note with an em dash, not `. ` as in the 8.3 example.
actions/002-single-step#steps: A lone step runs the legacy path: wrong message, and @Set sends a `set` event (6.3).
actions/003-event-context-any-value#step: The @ToAssistant context reaches the host as a string (6.3).
actions/004-event-form-state-per-step#st: Form state is read when the click starts, so an earlier @Set is not visible (6.3).
actions/005-query-args-references#steps: A reference in Query args is sent as null (6.1).
